SELECT r.*, e.name as employee_name, e.employee_no, e.entry_date, d.unit_name as dept_name, e.position as position_name, CASE WHEN d.unit_type = 2 THEN d.unit_name WHEN p1.unit_type = 2 THEN p1.unit_name WHEN p2.unit_type = 2 THEN p2.unit_name WHEN p3.unit_type = 2 THEN p3.unit_name ELSE NULL END as company_name FROM hr_regularization r LEFT JOIN hr_employee e ON r.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN org_unit d ON e.dept_id = d.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_unit p1 ON d.parent_id = p1.id AND p1.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_unit p2 ON p1.parent_id = p2.id AND p2.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_unit p3 ON p2.parent_id = p3.id AND p3.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted = 0
AND e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{employeeName}, '%')
AND r.status = #{status}
ORDER BY r.created_time DESC
